WIX WEBSITE REDESIGN WITH E-COMMERCE AND DIGITAL DOWNLOAD INTEGRATION

Published on the August 12, 2026 in IT & Programming

 * Project
 * Project Insights

ABOUT THIS PROJECT


IT-PROGRAMMING / E-COMMERCE

OPEN



A freelancer is needed to complete a comprehensive redesign of an existing Wix website. The project involves implementing a provided design to refresh the site's appearance and functionality. Key requirements include integrating a fully functional e-commerce store and enabling digital download capabilities for products. The successful candidate will work with the existing Wix platform to apply the new design and ensure all specified features are seamlessly integrated and operational.



Category IT & Programming
Subcategory E-commerce
What is the scope of the project? Medium-sized change


Delivery term: Not specified
